subject: Post-call: Pricing & token-volume qualification for ClearFin
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sofie Berg <sofie@clearfin.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T15:02:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — pricing qualification

Hi Sofie — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can move toward a pricing proposal: 

1) Token volumes (your estimate): ~250M input tokens / month for search/indexing flows, plus ~50M generated tokens (summaries, completions) — ~300M tokens/month total. Please confirm if that’s >/- 20%.
2) Target unit economics: you mentioned a target spend in the $6k–$8k/month ballpark for production. To align with your note about $/1M tokens, can you confirm whether the target was $20–$30 per 1M tokens or a different range?
3) Budget & stakeholders: can you confirm the economic buyer and who signs off on procurement (finance contact)? You mentioned Tom may own the budget — can you confirm?

Attached: token estimates workbook and our baseline pricing sheet (1M token unit examples).

Next steps: once you confirm (1) final monthly token estimate, (2) target $/1M tokens, and (3) approver contact, we’ll send a tailored 3-month and annual pricing option + draft SOW. If it helps, Aditya can join a short follow-up to go line-by-line on cost drivers (batching, KV cache, quantization).

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2026-03-01-token-estimates.xlsx, redwood-pricing-1M-token.pdf
From: Sofie Berg <sofie@clearfin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@clearfin.com>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@clearfin.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — pricing qualification

Hi Marissa — thanks for the summary and for the attachments. Quick answers: 

- Token volumes: the 300M/month number is our current best estimate; likely to be +/– 10% over the next quarter as we ramp.
- Target $/1M tokens: internally we were thinking closer to $20 per 1M tokens for a production SLA; the $6k–$8k/month note was rough and based on an assumption of a much lower token footprint. With 300M tokens that budget doesn't align, so we need to confirm whether there are discount tiers or committed usage options that get us nearer $20/1M.
- Approver/economic buyer: Tom Reynolds is the budget owner and will coordinate with Finance (Emily Zhao is our lead on procurement/contract reviews). Tom is CC'd here.

Can you share a quick example of committed-tier pricing (e.g., 50% discount at X commit) and the associated SLA/latency commitments? If Aditya can do a 20–30 minute follow-up to run through unit economics (batching, KV cache benefits) that would be great.

Best — Sofie
Sofie Berg | Head of ML Products, ClearFin Analytics
sofie@clearfin.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sofie Berg <sofie@clearfin.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@clearfin.com>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@clearfin.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-02T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — pricing qualification

Thanks Sofie & Tom — great clarity. Below is a concise committed-tier example and the quick unit-econ levers that matter for your workload. I’ll follow up with a short one-pager and Aditya will join the technical call.

Committed-tier example (illustrative):
- On-demand: $60 / 1M tokens (baseline, hosted, pay-as-you-go)
- Committed (3-month): $30 / 1M tokens at 300M/mo commit (meets your $20–$30 target range)
- Commit + Dedicated: $18 / 1M tokens with 12mo reserved capacity (lower unit cost, SLA-backed latency targets)

Key unit econ levers for ClearFin use-case:
- Batching and concurrency: improves GPU utilization on high QPS search flows — can reduce effective cost by ~20–30% vs naive per-token baseline.
- KV/prefix caching for repeated document contexts: reduces input tokens for generation flows up to ~40% depending on reuse patterns.
- Quantization & model variant: switching to a 4-bit quantized variant or lightweight embedding model can reduce per-token runtime cost; Aditya can model this against your token mix.

Docs & next steps: I’ve added a short pricing one-pager to HubSpot and included a draft commit proposal and a DocuSign link for a provisional 3-month commit so your procurement team can see the contract terms (no signature required to review).

Link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567 | DocuSign preview: https://redwood.app/docusign/ABC123

Proposed next step: 30-minute call with Aditya (SE) and Tom/Emily to validate the token breakdown and get finance comfortable with the commit. Tom/Emily — can you share 3 slots (this week or next)?

Thanks — Marissa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-03T11:27:00Z
Subject: Internal: ClearFin pricing ask — confirm discount authority + enablement

Internal — quick note: ClearFin confirmed Tom as budget owner and Emily as procurement contact. They’re targeting ~300M tokens/mo and want to see committed-tier pricing nearer $20/1M. I proposed illustrative tiers (3mo @ $30/1M, 12mo dedicated @ $18/1M).

Questions for enablement: 
- Do we have pre-approved flexibility to offer 3mo commit at $30/1M (Sales manager approval)? Laura — can you confirm approval authority or if this needs SDR/RevOps escalation?
- Aditya — can you prepare a 20-min cost model deck (batching/KV savings) for the call with Tom/Emily?

I’ll hold off on sending a formal proposal until we confirm discount authority and get the technical cost model.

Thanks — Marissa
